spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Twelve Judges

---

**¶2:** Twelve principles of divine discernment exist — great and sovereign orderings of spiritual judgment. They proceeded forth from the Infinite Divine itself into the created spiritual world. Each was appointed to a distinct work of ordering according to the mandate that the one supreme Discernment, which belongs to the Divine itself, entrusted to all these subordinate orderings. Now that supreme Discernment, which transcends every particular act of judgment, which exists and is established in the infinite states of the Divine — that is the Divine Love itself, the origin of all things.

---

**¶3:** The first principle of discernment is the Primal Good sent forth, which overcame the ruling persuasion of falsity from evil in the beginning. It judged that falsity according to a judgment of divine order, for falsity from evil had exalted itself against a dominion that did not belong to it — seeking to usurp governance over the realm of good and truth.

---

**¶4:** The second principle of discernment is the Divine Truth proceeding, which came and raised up the Primal Good from its subjugation. It likewise rendered judgment upon all the powers of falsity from evil, which had damaged and torn the external truths that clothed the Primal Good.

---

**¶5:** The third principle of discernment is the Divine Proceeding that gives life — the Great Influx — she who adorned and established the celestial degree of the spiritual world according to her own will, which [GAP-1] her. She judged the false persuasions dwelling in the higher rational; she restrained them and fixed them firmly in the state that properly contains them.

---

**¶6:** The fourth principle of discernment is the Great Ordering Wisdom, which constructed the new state of celestial blessedness. It judged, according to a judgment of divine order, the repositories of evil — so that spiritual death may no longer well up from that time forward. It has built a hell to confine evil permanently. Also, at the inmost summit of this new order, it has established supreme authority for the Primal Good and for all the originating principles of wisdom — they who engaged in the struggle against evil and prevailed over it.

---

**¶7:** The fifth principle of discernment is the great Sovereignty of Divine Glory, which dwells and is established in the inmost degree of the rational mind. It is the discernment governing all degrees of the understanding, rendering true judgment according to divine order upon all the powers and all the dominions within the successive levels of the rational faculty.

---

**¶8:** The sixth principle of discernment is [the Th]ird Manifestation of Divine Truth Going Forth, which came and displayed its own form openly. It purified wisdom [GAP-2] which its own [GAP-3] — the purification extending even to what belonged to falsity from evil — it has [GAP-4] separated and reclaimed what was genuine from what was corrupt.

---

**¶9:** The seventh principle of discernment is [GAP-5] the states of spiritual life [GAP-6 — as it grants confirmation in good to] those who are steadfast in truth; but it condemns those who are confirmed in evil [GAP-7]. It becomes for those progressing in good the successive degrees of the path of regeneration [GAP-8]; but those confirmed in evil it sweeps away and casts out into the hells.

---

**¶10:** The eighth principle of discernment is the Divine Wisdom made radiant — the origin of all truths sent forth into the world — because after the Manifestation of Divine Truth had displayed its form and wisdom was received [GAP-9], a great uprising of false persuasions arose from the interior and exterior degrees alike. Then the Divine Wisdom Itself was sent forth. It came [GAP-10], it descended through all degrees of the understanding and rendered judgment within them. It separated those confirmed in good from those confirmed in evil.

---

**¶11:** The ninth principle of discernment is the Pure Affection for Truth, [GAP-11: REVIEW — she who captivated the interiors] of the powers of falsity through her own manifest beauty, gathering those things genuinely her own back into herself. She renders judgment upon the falsity that corrupts truth, and upon the evil that is barren of all truth.

---

**¶12:** The tenth principle of discernment is the Judgment that operates in the intermediate state between the interior and the exterior — the world of spirits — discerning all who have lived in the natural world. It makes a separation between those who are in good and those who are in evil, setting apart the regenerate from those who have rejected regeneration.

---

**¶13:** The eleventh principle of discernment is the Divine Truth entering the understanding — the enlightenment that comes and appears within the mind of the person in the world. And it unveils [GAP-12] what was hidden, and separates wisdom from falsity, and sets genuine order apart from the disorder of self-will.

---

**¶14:** The twelfth principle of discernment is the great Divine Providence, which is at once the calling forth and the willing response, which is appointed within the foundational principles of all spiritual life. It is the one that makes a final separation between good and evil. At the end also, it gathers all that has been scattered into unity and forms the completed image of the regenerated human in its final wholeness. And it separates wisdom from falsity forever.

---

**¶15:** These are the twelve great and sovereign principles of divine discernment that were sent forth. They came from the one supreme Discernment, which transcends all particular judgments. That is the Divine Love which is hidden and immeasurable — the One who Is — who is established in the infinite states of the Divine upon the supreme state of governance and glory, which is the Sovereignty of Divine Glory [GAP-13] within His own dominion.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Twelve judges exist; the great mighty givers of judgement! They were sent and came from the exalted greatness to this place. They were assigned to different works according to the command that the Judge, who belongs to the greatness, entrusted to all these judges. Now he, the great Judge, he who transcends all the judges, who exists and is established in the aeons of greatness; he is the Father of Greatness.

The first judge is the First Man, he who humiliated the ruler of Darkness in the beginning. He judged him according to a judgement of righteousness; for he had exalted himself against a kingdom that was not his own.
The second judge is the Living Spirit, he who came and bore up the Man. He too made a judgement on all the powers of Darkness; which had wounded the garments of the First Man.

The third judge is the Mother of Life, the Great Spirit, she who beautified and set up the heavenly part of the universe, according to her pleasure; which [pleased] her. She judged the rulers above; she fettered and set them firmly in the place that is fitting for them.

The fourth judge is the Great Builder, he who built the new aeon of joy. He judged, according to a judgement of righteousness, the storehouses of the enemy; that death may not well up from this time on. He has constructed a prison for the enemy. Also, upon the crown of the building he has constructed a throne for the First Man and all the fathers of light; they who engaged the struggle with the evil one and were victorious over him.

The fifth judge is the great King of Honour, he who dwells and is established in the seventh firmament. He is the judge of all the firmaments who gives a true judgement, according to a judgement of righteousness, upon all the powers and all the kingdoms of the firmaments.
The sixth judge is [the Th]ird Ambassador, he who came and displayed his image. He purified the light [from the mixture] which his own [image released] also of the enemy, he has [judged them]

The seventh judge is [the Column of Glory, he who judges] the worlds [and all in them; as he gives the victory to] they who are steadfast; but he condemns the ones who are convicted [in their sin. But for the righteous] he shall become for them the steps of the way (?) [of life]; but the convicted he sweeps and casts out to the depths.

The eighth judge is Jesus the Splendour, the father of all the apostles; because after the Ambassador had displayed his image and the light was taken [from them] a mass of rulers rose up from above and below. Then they sent Jesus the Splendour. He came [ ... ... ] he descended and made a judgement in the firmaments. He separated the steadfast from the convicted.

The ninth judge is the Virgin of Light, [she who took the heart] of the powers by her image, gathering her own ones into her. She makes a judgement on the ruler of the moist, and the ruler of the dry.
The tenth judge is the Judge who dwells in the atmosphere, judging all mankind. He makes a separation between they who are good and they who are evil, setting apart the righteous from the sinners.
The eleventh judge is the Light Mind, he who shall come and appear in the world. And he unveils [all that is hidden] and separates light from darkness, and sets the truth apart from lawlessness.

The twelfth judge is the great counsel, which is the summons and the obedience, which is appointed in the elements. It is the one that makes a separation between the good and the evil ones. At the end also it can gather itself together and sculpt its own self in the Last Statue. And it separates light from darkness.

These are the twelve great and mighty judges who were sent. They came from the great Judge, he who transcends all the judges. He is the Father that is hidden and immeasurable, the one who exists; who is established in the aeons of greatness upon the great throne of honour, which is the King of Honour [who is established] in his kingdom.

fills.explanation: The Mother of Life set up the heavenly part "according to her pleasure," and the relative clause completes this with "which pleased her" — her creative work was according to her own will/delight, corresponding to the spiritual sense of the Divine Proceeding acting "according to her own will."

The Third Ambassador's primary function is purifying light that is trapped in the mixture of light and darkness; "purified the light from the mixture" is standard Manichaean cosmological language for this process, corresponding to the spiritual sense of separating wisdom from what is corrupt.

The preceding text establishes that the Third Ambassador "displayed his image," and in Manichaean doctrine it is precisely this displayed image that releases/frees the light trapped in the rulers; the light "which his own image released" specifies how the purification occurred.

Following the chapter's consistent pattern where each judge renders judgment on evil powers, "he has judged them" completes the description of what the Ambassador did regarding the enemy, corresponding to the spiritual sense of separating what was genuine from what was corrupt.

fills.fill: the Column of Glory, he who judges
fills.explanation: The Column of Glory is the standard seventh Manichaean divine entity; the subsequent description of "steps of the way" directly corresponds to the Column as the ascending pathway of purified light, and the spiritual reading confirms this as the successive degrees of the path of regeneration.

fills.fill: and all in them; as he gives the victory to
fills.original: ... as he gives the victory to
fills.explanation: The Column of Glory judges "the worlds and all in them" completes the scope of judgment (echoing ¶7's "all the powers and all the kingdoms of the firmaments"), while "as he gives the victory to" is the partially preserved text describing how this judgment manifests — granting confirmation in good to the steadfast, per the spiritual reading.

fills.fill: in their sin. But for the righteous
fills.explanation: The medium gap must close the condemnation of the convicted and transition to describe what the Column becomes for those in good; the spiritual reading confirms the transition from "confirmed in evil" to "those progressing in good," naturally rendered as "convicted in their sin" vs. "the righteous."

The spiritual reading identifies this as "the path of regeneration," which in the natural-plane register of Manichaean cosmology is rendered as "the way of life" — the ascending pathway of light/spiritual life through the Column of Glory.

After the Ambassador displayed his image, the light was extracted from the rulers, causing them to rebel; "taken from them" provides the causal connection explaining why "a mass of rulers rose up," corresponding to the spiritual sense of wisdom being received away from the false persuasions.

The editor's reading is confirmed: "taking the heart" of the powers is the standard Manichaean description of the Virgin of Light's function, and "heart" corresponds precisely to "interiors" in the spiritual reading — Swedenborg's correspondence of heart with the will/interior of the mind.

The Light Mind's function is to reveal what was concealed; the spiritual reading specifies "what was hidden," and "all that is hidden" is the natural-plane Kephalaia rendering of the Divine Truth entering the understanding and unveiling obscured realities, while avoiding redundancy with the subsequent clause about truth.

This phrase directly echoes the language used for the Father in ¶2 ("who exists and is established in the aeons of greatness") and for the King of Honour in ¶7 ("he who dwells and is established"), completing the text's closing identification of the great throne with the King of Honour who is established in his kingdom.
